claim: The PR fixes the file reference at line 65 of `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/Basic.lean` but leaves another stale one in the same file. Line 130, the comment above `Functor.comp_id` / `Functor.id_comp`, reads "Natural isomorphisms are also provided in `Whiskering.lean`." The path is in the short form this PR expands everywhere else, and it points to the wrong file. The natural isomorphisms `Functor.rightUnitor : F ⋙ 𝟭 D ≅ F` and `Functor.leftUnitor : 𝟭 C ⋙ F ≅ F` that go with these equalities are defined in `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/Category.lean`. `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Whiskering.lean` only proves the triangle and pentagon identities about them.
requested_change: In `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/Basic.lean`, replace line 130, "-- Natural isomorphisms are also provided in `Whiskering.lean`.", with the two lines "-- The natural isomorphisms `Functor.rightUnitor` and `Functor.leftUnitor` are provided in" and "-- `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/Category.lean`.", so that the comment names the file that defines these isomorphisms, using the full-path spelling this PR uses elsewhere.
evidence: I searched every changed file for path-like references. This one is the only short-form path left in a file the PR touches. `content_search` for `^(protected )?def (leftUnitor|rightUnitor|associator)` under Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor found `leftUnitor` at line 158 of Functor/Category.lean (`𝟭 C ⋙ F ≅ F`), `rightUnitor` at line 166 (`F ⋙ 𝟭 D ≅ F`) and `associator` at line 177. The same search on Whiskering.lean found no definitions, and its module doc (lines 26-27) says it only shows that these satisfy the triangle and pentagon identities. Zulip thread 'Broken file references' (Eric Wieser and Yael Dillies, 2024-11-04) supports using the full path spelling in docs, which is what this PR does. I tested the replacement with `lean_verify_edit` in line mode (line 130 replaced by the two-line comment): success, no errors, no warnings.
